mode: isolated, read-only source and datasets; no account mutations
status: exploratory; all eight existing datasets have already been observed
signalDefinition: btc-v2 eligibility false-to-true transition at a closed minute, identical to backtester; record rejected/unfilled signals too
entryAnchor: next contiguous minute open; horizons end at close of entry+horizon-1 minute; research outcomes never used in selection
primaryExploratoryContrast: btc-v2 minus matched C at 60m, net market-entry/market-exit return

groups.A-random: seeded simple random closed decision minutes from same period, excluding emitted btc-v2 signals, no matching
groups.B-uptrend: random minutes satisfying original primaryTrend 1h, excluding emitted btc-v2 signals
groups.C-trend-incomplete: primaryTrend true and full eligibility false
groups.D-momentum: primaryTrend true and trailing 15m close return > 0.2%; false-to-true transitions
groups.E-pullback: primaryTrend true, close < SMA21 and trailing 5m close return < 0; false-to-true transitions

matching.unmatchedPolicy: leave unmatched; never relax volatility or regime; report coverage and fallback

lateEntryHypothesis: recent 100bar range position >= 0.8 AND prior 15m return >0 AND MACD histogram below 5 minutes earlier; compare prevalence and forward returns to matched uptrend controls
componentSampling: fixed-seed sample at most 1000 closed minutes per component per period; raw component analysis is unadjusted and not a standalone executable strategy

uncertainty.primaryDifferences: paired case minus mean matched controls, day-block bootstrap
uncertainty.dependenceLimits: 24h blocks may not absorb longer persistence; report distinct days and deduplicate controls; 5-day block sensitivity on primary contrast
uncertainty.multipleTesting: Holm correction for 5 matched/unmatched group contrasts x 6 horizons on pooled expanded history; descriptive intervals otherwise

costModel: reuse PaperExecutionAdapter for standalone research entry and bounded market/limit exit, original config, 30USDT budget; no capacity or portfolio admission assumed; actual strategy fills reported separately
gapPolicy: quarantine invalid original bars without replacing them; reset all feature histories; censor each forward horizon crossing a gap or dataset boundary; no synthetic candles
windows: original 28: raw 120m before and 120m after entry, plus causal feature snapshots; stop study requires full future coverage and reports censoring
